verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is a government industrial-property service with online filing, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence covers only patent, trademark and design procedures and online requests, with no CLI or command-line tooling of any kind, and the llms.txt probe returned 404. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
